answer.summary: Two deterministic architecture-rule failures, not flakes, and both point at files this change touched. TenantBackgroundTransactionArchTest flags CatalogListService.offered self-invoking the @Transactional released() method (CatalogListService.java:41), a bypassed-proxy bug that will repeat on every run. JsonTypeDirtyOnLoadCoverageTest fails because the JSON-mapped fields in tenant-active tables no longer match the probe list, likely from the changed Inject/ScenarioRevision model. Infra noise at the Jackson '<' parse error is unrelated. Fix the self-invocation and the probe list, then re-run.
